milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the pink stained glass block (within 5 blocks) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the eye-level pink stained glass at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7), which is the nearest and most visible of the three pink stained glass blocks in the stone brick building. A 5-block max_distance requires active navigation from spawn (~8.6 blocks away) while being generous enough to not require pixel-perfect positioning. 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the target.
